name: OurMine
iocPatterns: Phishing attempts via DMs or emails
recommendedActions: Monitor for unauthorized access to high-profile accounts
Educate employees on phishing and social engineering tactics
campaignsText: OurMine has conducted multiple high-profile campaigns, including attacks on HBO and major tech companies. Their operational pattern involves quick compromises and subsequent claims via public channels, often using social media as a platform to announce their activities.
description: OurMine, a self-proclaimed white hat hacking group, targets high-profile social media accounts, including those of celebrities, HBO, Marvel, and tech CEOs, primarily to showcase their skills and attract attention.
goals: OurMine targets high-profile individuals and organizations in sectors such as entertainment, media, and technology. Their goals are primarily to gain notoriety and attract attention to their hacking capabilities rather than achieve traditional strategic or financial objectives. The targeting of well-known figures and major companies suggests a desire to demonstrate skill level and reach.
